content.text:
I reviewed `0.html` — it's already a well-built, accessible interactive demo (proper ARIA, reduced-motion/forced-colors/contrast handling, long-press/double-tap logic, bfcache/storage sync). A few concrete things I could improve, want me to do any/all of these?

1. **Real favicon** — currently `href="data:,"` (empty data URI) just suppresses the 404; could add a tiny inline SVG favicon matching the circle.
2. **`aria-label` doesn't reflect state** — the button always says "Change circle color"; could append the current/next color for clearer screen-reader feedback (e.g., "Change circle color, currently Blue").
3. **Long-press has no visual/haptic progress indicator** — user gets no feedback until the 500ms fires; a subtle CSS transition (e.g., a ring filling) would make it discoverable.
4. **`config.keySteps` collapses Up/Down and Left/Right to the same step** — arguably fine, but Right/Down going the same direction as Left/Up could confuse some users; could make Down mirror Right and Up mirror Left (already does) — just flagging as a design choice, not a bug.
5. **No `<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable">`/manifest** — minor PWA polish, only relevant if this is meant to be installable.

None of these are bugs — the code is solid. Let me know which improvements you actually want (or describe what "improve" means for your use case), and I'll implement them.
